LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrgan.label: voice organ
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrgan.description: A communication organ that requires a living carrier. The carrier neither ages nor hungers inside, and their Social skill affects trade terms. The organ speaks in their voice, passing the flesh colony off as a human settlement.
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrganEmbryo.label: voice organ embryo
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrganEmbryo.description: An immature communication organ that will grow into a voice organ.
LanguageData.FB_FleshTradeBeacon.label: flesh trade beacon
LanguageData.FB_FleshTradeBeacon.description: A flesh beacon that lets the voice organ offer nearby goods to orbital traders. Available trades depend on the trader.
